value.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
value.text: In episode 89, Elena is carried off with Coulson's team to a space station in 2091, where the Kree capture her and Mack until Daisy frees them.

verdicts.why: The missing record is real, but Daisy frees Yo-Yo and Mack from the Kree within 'Orientation Part One' (episode 89, AoS501), and Yo-Yo then works on the station; she is not captive until episode 98, so 'Imprisoned' is wrong.

The record sums up through episode 110: future Enoch's apparent death is episode 98, but its last element, the present Enoch still travelling in space with Fitz in stasis, is what episode 110 'The End' establishes, so the tag fits.
Daredevil S3 episode 10 'Karen': Dex, dressed as Daredevil, kills Lantom at Clinton Church; episode 11 deals with the aftermath, so nothing in the record reaches episode 11.

The record's last event, Mace being hailed as an Inhuman, fits episode 71, where his public Inhuman reveal in the TV debate with Nadeer makes him more popular; in episode 67 he is not yet publicly hailed as Inhuman, so the move adds an error.
Iron Fist S1 episode 3 'Rolling Thunder Cannon Punch': Hogarth promises to reclaim Danny's identity for a permanent contract and proves it with fingerprint evidence; episode 4 has no such event.

Hunter comes in leading S.H.I.E.L.D.-hired mercenaries (episode 23, Creel's attack kills Hartley), Coulson asks him to stay in episode 24, Bobbi joins only in episode 27, and in episode 37 Hunter agrees to become a permanent agent; 'on Bobbi's word' is false.

The record sums up episodes 5 and 11: the Reyes warning is episode 5 and the offer of a way in (a meeting with her firm) is episode 11, its last event, so under the summing convention the text and tag are both correct.

The record sums up through episode 109: May confesses her love in episode 105, but Coulson answers by kissing her behind his energy shield aboard Qovas' ship in 'The Force of Gravity' (AoS521, episode 109), so 'she and Coulson finally admit their feelings' ends in 109.
Ellison digs into the Punisher with Karen in episodes 5, 9 and 10, but he officially offers her a job in episode 12 (DD212), which is the record's last event, so episode 12 is right.
The record sums up episodes 2 and 9 and its last event (the news showing Frank alive) is episode 9 (TP109), so the tag is correct, and dropping an episode tag is never accepted.

value.text: In episode 81, Piper flees the Playground on the Zephyr as it is blown up, then helps log Daisy and Simmons into the Framework.

verdicts.why: Piper helps log Daisy and Simmons into the Framework aboard Zephyr One in AoS415 (episode 81), after escaping as the May LMD's bomb destroys the Playground; in episode 86 she only guards them as power runs out. The base is blown up, so 'burning' is changed.
Agent Carter S1 episode 3 'Time and Tide': an assassin shoots Krzeminski and the guard after a staged car crash; he does not appear alive in episode 8.
Nadeem breaks with Fisk's plan at the church and, when Fisk's agents attack his home, fights them off with Matt, who unmasks to him, in episode 11; the testimony and death are episode 12 (k1).

The record sums up through episode 110: Robin draws the clue in episode 104, and in episode 110 the team rescues her and Polly from Talbot's crashed ship in Chicago, which fits 'the team saves her from Talbot'. The proposal is a rewrite of a record that is not wrong.
VisionQuest episode 1 'No Strings': Paladin captures Thomas Shepherd, who claims to be Vision's son; in episode 2 Vision frees him, so an 'Imprisoned' record tagged episode 2 is wrong.

Episode 5 shows Ultron letting Paladin kidnap Tommy; in episode 6 Paladin brings him to Madripoor to blackmail Vision, Tommy and Lisa hijack Paladin's van, and Tommy deactivates Jocasta's nanobot in Lisa. The file has no record of this.

value.title: VisionQuest
value.text: In episode 6, after lowering his firewall to retake his body, which lets Ultron escape, Vision reaches Madripoor with Lisa, fights off the Ten Rings with Tommy's help, and flees with him.

verdicts.why: The record is missing, but its last event is not episode 5: Vision wakes on the plane to Madripoor at the end of episode 5, and the Madripoor fight and getting Tommy back are episode 6, where Tommy and Lisa free themselves by hijacking Paladin's van, so 'rescues Tommy from Paladin' overstates it.
Valentina sends Yelena after Clint in the Black Widow post-credits scene, and the whistle moment is in their fight in Hawkeye episode 6, so k1 belongs after k2, beside k3.
Dropping an episode tag is never accepted, and the record's last event (TVA agents shown to be variants, via B-15 and C-20) is in Loki S1 episode 4, so the tag is correct for a summary record.
Dropping an episode tag is never accepted, and the record's last event, Riri making peace with Xavier, is in Ironheart episode 5 'Karma's a Glitch', so the tag is correct.
